result:
The build succeeds cleanly with 0 warnings and 0 errors. 

I've implemented all three missing operations in `Spans.calr`, following the conventions of the existing `TotalCovered` (`§WH` loops, `§LEN`/`§IDX`, `§ASSIGN`, pure `§E{}`, and contracts):

1. **`ContainsPoint`** — scans intervals, returns `true` if `starts[i] <= x < ends[i]` (half-open, so `x == ends[i]` is excluded). Guards length equality.

2. **`ClipCovered`** — for each interval, clamps start up to `lo` and end down to `hi`, adding the positive overlap to the total. Preconditions `lo <= hi` and equal lengths; postcondition `result >= 0`.

3. **`GapCount`** — counts consecutive pairs where `starts[i+1] - ends[i] > 0` (strictly positive gaps; touching intervals excluded). Returns `0` for zero/one interval since the loop guard `i+1 < len` never enters. Postcondition `result >= 0`.

The spec is fully satisfied and the project builds cleanly.
